Elena Ruiz — Human Factors & Single-Operator Safety said about it: I take from the push it or pull it erg033 - m-and-m-you-pull-it (E32) that for pushing the handle should be between elbow and hip and vertical handles for pushing should cover about 76 cm to 120 cm above the rolling surface, and I take from the Reducing Ergonomic Hazards - HME Business (E31) that vertical handles let all staff push at elbow height.
